name: Kumanomidou Ayane
source:
Affiliation: Luminous Academy Middle School Section, class 3-B
Class: Diva Princess
Hobbies: Sharing videos, DTM

[url=/c33539]Hiyoko's[/url] best friend and classmate, the two have known each other ever since elementary school. Naturally airheaded and carefree, Ayane gets along with almost anybody, regardless of their age or gender. She is quite popular on the internet due to her own show as a net idol. She started her career as a net idol due to her brother's influence, who is an idol otaku.
